title: A Day at the Apothecary: Small Business Saturday at Agape Apothecary
seo_title: Small Business Saturday at Agape Apothecary, Springfield
description: This is a Small Business Saturday gathering at Agape Apothecary where you can sip herbal tea, make your own single-serving tea blend, and browse handmade herbal products. It suits holiday gift shoppers and anyone curious about the Apothecary, and it is free to attend. It runs Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM at 1740 S. Glenstone, Suite A, in Springfield, MO, and you can come and go during those hours.
venue: 1740 S. Glenstone, Suite A, Springfield, MO 65804
